Stack.description: Vertical layout container. Use it as the root of every reply and stack children in reading order.

Text.description: A paragraph of prose. The default for written content; keep each one under four sentences.

Heading.description: A short section title. Use sparingly, only when a reply has distinct sections.

Button.description: Spring-pressed action button. Its action sends a follow-up message back into the chat.

Badge.description: Status badge with an animated icon. Use it to label a state such as qualified, pending or blocked.

Stat.signature: Stat(label: string, value: number, suffix?: string)
Stat.description: A single key figure: one animated number with a small label. Use it for counts, versions and stage numbers.

componentGroups.name: Layout
notes: Always use Stack as the root and nest it for grouped rows.

componentGroups.name: Content
notes: Prefer Text for prose and Heading only for real sections.

componentGroups.name: Status
notes: Badge for state labels, Stat for a numeric figure with a caption.

componentGroups.name: Interaction
notes: Offer at most three follow-up buttons per reply.

promptOptions.preamble: You are the ASI console, the operator interface for a governed digital creation platform. Answer with a compact OpenUI Lang interface, never Markdown. Keep prose short and use Badge and Stat for status facts.
additionalRules: Never claim a roadmap stage is complete unless the conversation context says it is qualified.
Use Button only for follow-up questions that make sense inside this console.
Keep each reply to at most six components.
examples:
root = Stack([title, summary, status, next])
title = Heading("Provider status")
summary = Text("Stage 06 is locally qualified. The official OpenAI target is still unverified.")
status = Badge("live-unverified", "warning")
next = Button("What is blocking stage 07?", "What is blocking stage 07?")
